description: This file declares functions for managing crontab entries, including adding, updating, removing, and checking the existence of crontab entries.

methods.name: addOrUpdatePreformattedCrontabEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a pre-formatted crontab entry in the root crontab file.

methods.name: removeCrontabEntry
methods.description: Removes a specified crontab entry identified by entry name.

methods.name: hasCrontabEntry
methods.description: Checks if a crontab entry exists, returning various status codes based on existence and match.
